[[img:bullet_armies]][[/img]]Armies of Tilea: reliable and heavily-armoured roster, with better artillery and cavalry than their neighbours.
[[img:bullet_armies]][[/img]]Armies of Estalia: reliable and heavily-armoured roster, with versatile Conquistador units.
[[img:bullet_armies]][[/img]]Armies of the Borderlands: jack-of-all-trades roster of skirmishers, specialists and cost-effective compromises.
[[img:bullet_armies]][[/img]]Colonial Armies: jack-of-all-trades roster that combines many of the individual strengths of the homeland with fewer of their elites.

[[img:plutocracy]][[/img]] [[col:white]]Plutocracy[[/col]]\\n[[col:green]]Use your {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury, when strategically viable, to fund [[img:ui/skins/default/browser_spell_tab_character.png]][[/img]]specific agents or even unique characters, hire special [[img:ui/skins/default/icon_effect_ror.png]][[/img]]Regiments of Renown, purchase [[img:icon_prologue_character]][[/img]]character items, and [[img:ui/skins/default/icon_factions.png]][[/img]]initiate temporary factionwide bonuses. \\n\\nSouthern Realms have few ways of reducing expenses but many to increase income, particularly from ports buildings and province capitals.[[/col]]

[[img:bullet_armies]][[/img]] [[col:white]]Rosters of the Southern Realms[[/col]]\\n[[col:green]]The Southern Realms are not only politically divided, but also split into four subgroups: [[img:tilea]][[/img]]Tileans, [[img:estalia]][[/img]]Estalians, [[img:border]][[/img]]Border Princes and [[img:nwc]][[/img]]Colonies. Each of these has access to different variations and combinations of different units, down to where exactly they are recruitable. A province may focus more on city levies or mercenary camps, and you may swap between their two [[img:ui/skins/default/icon_recruit_without_border.png]][[/img]]recruitment chains.\\n\\nSouthern Realms rosters benefit particularly from [[img:ui/skins/default/experience_9.png]][[/img]]experience, including the wide offer of [[img:ui/skins/default/icon_effect_ror.png]][[/img]]Regiments of Renown.[[/col]]
